comment: Keyed rate limits for outbound sources (kernel/sciforge/limiter.py). A key with no entry here is unlimited. min_interval_s = polite spacing; default_retry_after_s = assumed backoff when upstream 429 has no Retry-After; max_cooldown_s = clamp on honor-the-upstream wait. Sources with hard courtesy limits (arXiv 1req/3s) and gateway models observed 429-ing at free-tier token/min caps get an entry; everything else is pass-through.
